requirements.title: Comprehensive Lead Management System
requirements.description: A system to manage leads from capture to conversion, including lead scoring, nurturing, and assignment.

requirements.title: Deal Pipeline Management
requirements.description: A visual and interactive system to manage the sales pipeline, including deal stages, probabilities, and forecasting.

requirements.title: Advanced Reporting and Analytics
requirements.description: A reporting system that allows for the creation of custom reports, including data visualization, filtering, and real-time updates.

requirements.title: User Interface and Experience
requirements.description: An intuitive and user-friendly interface for sales representatives and managers, including customizable dashboards and workflows.

requirements.title: Security and Access Control
requirements.description: Robust security measures to protect data, including multi-factor authentication, access controls, and data encryption.

requirements.title: Integration and Interoperability
requirements.description: The ability to integrate with other systems and tools, including calendar, email, and CRM systems, for seamless workflow and data synchronization.

requirements.title: Automated Workflows and Notifications
requirements.description: Automated workflows for lead nurturing, deal stage updates, and notifications to enhance efficiency and reduce manual effort.

requirements.title: Data Import and Export
requirements.description: Capabilities for bulk data import and export, including validation, deduplication, and error reporting.

requirements.title: Audit and Compliance
requirements.description: A comprehensive audit log and compliance system to track all data modifications and ensure regulatory adherence.

requirements.title: Training and Support
requirements.description: Ongoing training and support for users, including documentation, webinars, and direct assistance.

requirements.title: Customization and Scalability
requirements.description: The ability to customize the system to meet specific business needs and scale as the business grows.
